title: 第3章 成了第4章 帮忙
content_zh:
声音很轻，但似乎还是惊扰到了这位神明，她抬起手，指尖相抵，周身的气开始产生变化。
沈二鬼使神差地盘腿坐下，双手学着虚影的样子，在胸口结出一个简单的手印。在她闭上眼的瞬间，一直蛰伏在她体内的那丝暖流忽然剧烈地涌动。
“咳……”沈二身体微颤，各处经脉像是被强行挤压后打通了一般，传来阵阵酸麻刺痛。但她没有停下来，有种近乎本能的直觉告诉她，这是机缘，是活下去的生路。
她咬紧牙关，忍受着经脉拓宽带来的不适，全身心沉浸在那股暖流与外来能量的交融之中。
不知过了多久，沈二体内奔涌的力量慢慢平息下来，最终归于丹田。她睁开眼，虚影在这时换了个手势——右手两指并拢，指尖置于眉心处。
沈二抬手照做，学着她的样子闭上眼，脑海中，一道温柔好听的女音响起：“想着要去往的位置，驱动丹田。”
这声音……好听到沈二麻了半边身子，不愧是神仙姐姐，人美，声音也好听。
“叩！”后脑凭空挨了一记。
“咳咳……”沈二清了清嗓子，收起异样的心思，神仙交给她的应该是类似于瞬间移动的法术，那就先到黑蛇的后边试试。
想着想要去往的位置，驱动丹田……
下一刻，沈二身形一晃，仅仅是半息之间，便出现在黑蛇身后。
“呕——咳咳咳……”沈二一阵晕头转向，扶墙干呕。方才那一下子，她人像是被强行从那边扯到这边，站稳后整个脑子都在晃。
待她缓过神来，虚影已经消失不见，仿佛从未出现过。空气墙依然存在，有所不同的是，墙上凭空出现一扇石门，在旁边浮现出一行星星汇聚成的小字。
奈何沈二不识字……
盯着那行字看了半天也没看出个所以然来，“这写的什么？”她低头看向脚边的黑蛇，“你认识吗？”
蛇也在看她，尾巴一摇一摇的。
石门是锁死的，门上有一个锁孔，那锁孔的形状跟她以往常见的都不一样。
看着像一朵花，五瓣，沈二脑中灵光乍现，当即就想到了母亲留下的那个发簪。
木制的发簪，样式类似于一枝梅，不过比一枝梅更胖更丑点，上面雕琢出来的梅花形状与这锁孔一般无二。
看来要去门的那边，还得需要那支发簪。只是现在发簪在姜水依手里，沈二的心沉了下去，不死心地用力推了推石门，纹丝不动。

她在这里面待了不知多久，也不知现在外面是何光景。她估量了一下此刻的身体状况，虽远不如以前那般壮实，但至少不再是走几步，吹到风就咳嗽得要死的状态。
既然她活下来了，那该属于她的东西还是她的。
……??）?
“你确定是走这边吗？我怎么感觉有点不对劲。”
从秘境出来，外边的天还是黑的，蛇在前边窸窸窣窣地带着路，七拐八绕，走得沈二晕头转向。
蛇没有理会她，在干枯落叶上爬行，时不时停下来，伸直脑袋嗅嗅探探，然后继续爬。黑黑长长，滑溜溜的一条，沈二心中不禁生出恶寒，她确实挺讨厌这种长条无腿生物的。
走了许久，沈二发现不远处有火光，还隐隐听到有人说话。想来是山里的猎户在那边歇息，便想着过去问问路，说不准还能讨点吃的。在秘境待了那么些时辰，她实在是饿了。
扒开树丛走进光晕中，沈二整个人顿住。
content_en:
The voice was very soft, but it still seemed to disturb the god. She raised her hand, touched her fingertips, and the energy around her body began to change.
Shen Er sat down cross-legged by mistake, imitating the shadow's appearance with his hands, forming a simple handprint on his chest. The moment she closed her eyes, the warmth that had been dormant in her body suddenly surged violently.
"Cough..." Shen Er's body trembled slightly, and various meridians seemed to be opened after being forcibly squeezed, and there were waves of soreness, numbness and tingling. But she didn't stop. An almost instinctive intuition told her that this was an opportunity and a way to survive.
She gritted her teeth, endured the discomfort caused by the widening of her meridians, and immersed herself in the blend of warmth and external energy.
After an unknown amount of time, the power surging in Shen Er's body slowly calmed down and finally returned to his dantian. She opened her eyes, and Xuying changed her gesture at this moment - the two fingers of her right hand came together, and the fingertips were placed between the eyebrows.
Shen Er raised his hand and followed her instructions, imitating her example and closing his eyes. In his mind, a gentle and pleasant female voice sounded: "Think about where you want to go, and drive your Dantian."
This voice... was so good that half of Shen Er's body went numb. She was indeed a fairy sister, with a beautiful person and a pleasant voice.
"Knock!" He received a blow out of thin air on the back of his head.
"Ahem..." Shen Er cleared his throat and put away his strange thoughts. What the gods gave her should be a spell similar to teleportation, so she should try it behind the black snake first.
Thinking about where you want to go, drive your Dantian...
The next moment, Shen Er's body swayed, and in just half a breath, he appeared behind Black Snake.
"Ugh—cough cough cough..." Shen Er felt dizzy for a while, holding on to the wall and retching. At that moment, she seemed to be forcibly pulled from one side to the other, and her whole head was shaking after she stood firm.
By the time she regained consciousness, the shadow had disappeared, as if it had never appeared. The air wall still exists, but the difference is that a stone door appears out of thin air on the wall, and a group of small characters made of stars appear next to it.
But Shen Er is illiterate...
She stared at the line of writing for a long time without understanding it, "What does it say?" She lowered her head and looked at the black snake at her feet, "Do you recognize it?"
The snake was also looking at her, its tail wagging.
The stone door was locked, and there was a keyhole on the door. The shape of the keyhole was different from what she had seen before.
It looked like a flower with five petals. An idea flashed in Shen Er's mind, and he immediately thought of the hairpin left by his mother.
The style of the wooden hairpin is similar to the plum blossom, but it is fatter and uglier than the plum blossom. The shape of the plum blossom carved on it is the same as the keyhole.
It seems that to go to the other side of the door, you need that hairpin. But now that the hairpin was in Jiang Shuiyi's hand, Shen Er's heart sank, and he pushed the stone door hard without giving up, but it didn't move at all.
She had been here for who knows how long, and she didn't know what the scene was like outside now. She assessed her physical condition at the moment. Although she was not as strong as before, at least she was no longer in the state of coughing to death when the wind blew her after just a few steps.
Since she survived, what should belong to her is still hers.
…??)?
"Are you sure you want to go this way? I feel something is wrong."
After coming out of the secret realm, it was still dark outside, and the snake was rustling in front of him, leading the way, twisting and turning, making Shen Er dizzy.
The snake ignored her and crawled on the dry leaves, stopping from time to time, stretching its head to sniff, and then continued crawling. It was long and slippery, and Shen Er couldn't help but feel a chill in her heart. She really hated this kind of long, legless creature.
After walking for a long time, Shen Er found a fire not far away and heard someone talking faintly. I thought the hunters in the mountains were resting there, so I thought about going there to ask for directions and maybe get some food. After staying in the secret realm for so long, she was really hungry.
After pushing through the bushes and walking into the halo, Shen Er paused.
